mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have 54-degree weather at Reddan Soccer Park under a First Quarter moon. The ISS is passing by early tomorrow morning, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 42 degrees with no rain expected.

City officials are offering new stormwater utility credits for property owners who install rain gardens or barrels. Additionally, the police department is continuing to investigate after arresting a school bus driver for operating while impaired on October 15.
We have plenty going on in Verona, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee trivia nights.
In a notable weekly incident from October 13, police responded to a disturbance at a restaurant on East Verona Avenue, resulting in property bans and a citation for obstruction.
Enjoy the Caramel Peanut Buttercup flavor of the day at Culver's, which remains open until 10:00 PM this evening.
